intendedUse: Explore whether the proposed website structure and message are understandable enough to justify further testing. The prototype is not approved as an operational customer-contact channel.
workflowBoundary: A stakeholder opens the prototype and inspects the proposed customer journey.
workflowCompletion: The team can reproduce the prototype, inspect the proposed flow, and record the assumptions that still need testing.
downstreamHandoffs: Contact-flow verification before any reliance decision
movedBottleneck: If page generation becomes nearly instant, clarification of real business requirements and verification of the enquiry workflow become the next constraints.
unhappyPath: A page or interaction may look complete while the real downstream business process has not been connected or verified.

actors.role: AI-assisted prototype creation and stakeholder inspection

authority: Prototype-only. The record does not authorise customer reliance, production operation, or claims that enquiries reach the business.
accountability: The project owner decides whether the exploration has produced enough learning to continue.
demonstrated: A reproducible, inspectable prototype exists and the important assumptions are recorded.
knownLimitations: The enquiry/contact path has not been established as an operational workflow.
Production support, monitoring, recovery, and ownership are outside this exploration decision.
evidenceRefs: Illustrative prototype can be opened and inspected
Illustrative assumptions list is recorded with the prototype
nextEvidence: Before anyone may rely on the website, test the real enquiry path end to end and define acceptance criteria for the named use.
stopRule: Stop prototype iteration if stakeholder testing no longer removes meaningful uncertainty about the proposed direction.
